fit: native canvas 72x136, anchor bottom-centre (36,136); stage 384x224 at 16 px per tile; a knight is 12x20.
geometry: No hitbox. The hub pole: eight peg slots hold the banners; art fills them, rules decide which are up. The canvas is eight pixels wider than the slot (64x136) so the painted pole is not scaled.
timing: idle 1 ticks (30 Hz). Durations are the rules' and live in assets/bannerpeak/slots.json.
